tokenUri.description: Required. Immutable. The OAuth2 token request URL.

hostUri.description: Required. The host URI of the OAuth application.

serverVersion.description: Output only. SCM server version installed at the host URI.

clientSecret.description: Required. Input only. The client secret of the OAuth application. It will be provided as plain text, but encrypted and stored in developer connect. As INPUT_ONLY field, it will not be included in the output.

enumDescriptions: The SCM is not specified or BYO Account Connector is not an SCM.
BYO Account Connector is an instance of GitHub Enterprise.
BYO Account Connector is an instance of GitLab Enterprise.
BYO Account Connector is an instance of Bitbucket Data Center.
scmProvider.description: Required. The type of the SCM provider.

serviceDirectoryConfig.description: Optional. Configuration for using Service Directory to connect to a private service.

pkceDisabled.description: Optional. Disable PKCE for this OAuth config. PKCE is enabled by default.

commit.description: The commit metadata for this line range.

firstLine.description: The 1-indexed starting line number of the range (inclusive).

lastLine.description: The 1-indexed ending line number of the range (inclusive).

BlameRange.description: BlameRange represents blame information for a range of lines.

gitUsername.description: The git_username to specify when making a git clone with the token. For example, for GitHub GitRepositoryLinks, this would be "x-access-token"

expirationTime.description: Expiration timestamp. Can be empty if unknown or non-expiring.

FetchReadTokenResponse.description: Message for responding to get read token.

selector.description: The name of the parameter in the input_schema or output_schema.

restriction.description: The visibility restriction labels for this field (comma-separated).

FieldVisibility.description: Visibility rules for individual tool parameters (fields). This allows producers to hide specific fields in tools/list and tools/call.

GoogleCloudRun.description: GoogleCloudRun represents the Cloud Run runtime.

serviceUri.description: Required. Immutable. The name of the Cloud Run service. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/services/{service}`.

unreachable.description: Locations that could not be reached.

nextPageToken.description: A token identifying a page of results the server should return.

ListUsersResponse.description: Message for response to listing Users

author.description: Output only. The username of the author.

createTime.description: Output only. When the comment was created.

body.description: Required. The body of the comment.

updateTime.description: Output only. When the comment was updated.

id.description: Output only. The ID of the comment.

PullRequestComment.description: Message representing a SCM Pull Request Comment.

reconciling.description: Output only. Set to true when the connection is being set up or updated in the background.

githubEnterpriseConfig.description: Configuration for connections to an instance of GitHub Enterprise.

gitlabEnterpriseConfig.description: Configuration for connections to an instance of GitLab Enterprise.

name.description: Identifier. The resource name of the connection, in the format `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/connections/{connection_id}`.

bitbucketDataCenterConfig.description: Configuration for connections to an instance of Bitbucket Data Center.

bitbucketCloudConfig.description: Configuration for connections to an instance of Bitbucket Clouds.

etag.description: Optional. This checksum is computed by the server based on the value of other fields, and may be sent on update and delete requests to ensure the client has an up-to-date value before proceeding.

disabled.description: Optional. If disabled is set to true, functionality is disabled for this connection. Repository based API methods and webhooks processing for repositories in this connection will be disabled.

labels.description: Optional. Labels as key value pairs

uid.description: Output only. A system-assigned unique identifier for the Connection.

installationState.description: Output only. Installation state of the Connection.

httpConfig.description: Optional. Configuration for connections to an HTTP service provider.

annotations.description: Optional. Allows clients to store small amounts of arbitrary data.

cryptoKeyConfig.description: Optional. The crypto key configuration. This field is used by the Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) feature.

gitProxyConfig.description: Optional. Configuration for the Git proxy feature. Enabling the Git proxy allows clients to perform Git operations on the repositories linked in the connection. [Learn more](https://docs.cloud.google.com/developer-connect/docs/configure-git-proxy).

secureSourceManagerInstanceConfig.description: Configuration for connections to an instance of Secure Source Manager.

htmlUrl.description: Output only. The HTML URL of the pull request on the SCM provider.

author.description: Output only. The username of the author.

createTime.description: Output only. When the PR was created.

title.description: Required. The title of the PR.

mergeTime.description: Output only. When the PR was merged.

id.description: Optional. The ID of the PR, assigned by the SCM provider (for example, "45"). Ignored by `OpenGitRepositoryLinkPullRequest`.

declineTime.description: Output only. When the PR was declined. Only set for SCM providers that support declining pull requests. Never set for GitHub, GitHub Enterprise, GitLab, or GitLab Enterprise, where a pull request closed without being merged is `CLOSED`.

enumDescriptions: Mergeability state is unspecified.
The pull request can be merged cleanly without Git conflicts.
The pull request has merge conflicts and cannot be merged cleanly.
The mergeability state is currently being computed asynchronously by the upstream SCM provider.
mergeability.description: Output only. The mergeability state of the pull request.

updateTime.description: Output only. When the PR was updated.

enumDescriptions: Default value.
The PR is open.
The PR is closed.
The PR is merged.

The PR is declined. Only used by SCM providers that support declining pull requests. Never used for GitHub, GitHub Enterprise, GitLab, or GitLab Enterprise, where a pull request closed without being merged is `CLOSED`.
state.description: Output only. The current state of the PR.

body.description: Optional. The body description of the PR.

headRef.description: Required. The name of the source (head) branch that contains the changes.

baseRef.description: Required. The name of the target (base) branch that the changes are merged into.

closeTime.description: Output only. When the PR was closed.

PullRequest.description: Message representing a SCM Pull Request.

apiVersion.description: Output only. API version used to start the operation.

verb.description: Output only. Name of the verb executed by the operation.

endTime.description: Output only. The time the operation finished running.

target.description: Output only. Server-defined resource path for the target of the operation.

statusMessage.description: Output only. Human-readable status of the operation, if any.

requestedCancellation.description: Output only. Identifies whether the user has requested cancellation of the operation. Operations that have been cancelled successfully have google.longrunning.Operation.error value with a google.rpc.Status.code of 1, corresponding to `Code.CANCELLED`.

createTime.description: Output only. The time the operation was created.

OperationMetadata.description: Represents the metadata of the long-running operation.

id.description: ID of the installation in GitHub.

name.description: Name of the GitHub user or organization that owns this installation.

Installation.description: Represents an installation of the GitHub App.

httpProxyBaseUri.description: Output only. The base URI for the HTTP proxy endpoint. Has the format `https://{generatedID}-a-h-{shortRegion}.developerconnect.dev` Populated only when `enabled` is set to `true`. This endpoint is used by other Google services that integrate with Developer Connect.

enabled.description: Optional. Setting this to true allows the git and http proxies to perform actions on behalf of the user configured under the account connector.

ArtifactConfig.description: The artifact config of the artifact that is deployed.

uri.description: Required. Immutable. The URI of the artifact that is deployed. e.g. `us-docker.pkg.dev/my-project/my-repo/image`. The URI does not include the tag / digest because it captures a lineage of artifacts.

googleArtifactRegistry.description: Optional. Set if the artifact is stored in Artifact registry.

googleArtifactAnalysis.description: Optional. Set if the artifact metadata is stored in Artifact analysis.

AccountConnector.description: AccountConnector encapsulates what a platform administrator needs to configure for users to connect to the service providers, which includes, among other fields, the OAuth client ID, client secret, and authorization and token endpoints.

annotations.description: Optional. Allows users to store small amounts of arbitrary data.

oauthStartUri.description: Output only. Start OAuth flow by clicking on this URL.

updateTime.description: Output only. The timestamp when the accountConnector was updated.

uid.description: Output only. A system-assigned unique identifier for the Account Connector.

proxyConfig.description: Optional. Configuration for the http and git proxy features.

labels.description: Optional. Labels as key value pairs

etag.description: Optional. This checksum is computed by the server based on the value of other fields, and may be sent on update and delete requests to ensure the client has an up-to-date value before proceeding.

name.description: Identifier. The resource name of the accountConnector, in the format `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/accountConnectors/{account_connector_id}`.

createTime.description: Output only. The timestamp when the accountConnector was created.

httpProxyBaseUri.description: Output only. The base URI for the HTTP proxy endpoint. Has the format `https://{generatedID}-c-h-{shortRegion}.developerconnect.dev` Populated only when enabled is set to true. This endpoint is used by other Google services that integrate with Developer Connect.

enabled.description: Optional. Setting this to true allows the Git proxy to be used for performing Git operations on the repositories linked in the connection.

GitProxyConfig.description: Configuration for proxies. For legacy reasons, this message is named `GitProxyConfig`, but it includes settings for both Git and HTTP proxy.

ProcessBitbucketCloudWebhookRequest.description: RPC request object accepted by the ProcessBitbucketCloudWebhook RPC method.

files.description: The file diff extracted from the unified diff.

OAuthCredential.description: Represents an OAuth token of the account that authorized the Connection, and associated metadata.

oauthTokenSecretVersion.description: Required. A SecretManager resource containing the OAuth token that authorizes the connection. Format: `projects/*/secrets/*/versions/*` or `projects/*/locations/*/secrets/*/versions/*` (if regional secrets are supported in that location).

username.description: Output only. The username associated with this token.

criticality.description: Output only. The criticality of the App Hub Service.

apphubService.description: Required. Output only. Immutable. The name of the App Hub Service. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/applications/{application}/services/{service}`.

environment.description: Output only. The environment of the App Hub Service.

AppHubService.description: AppHubService represents the App Hub Service.

keyReference.description: Required. The name of the key which is used to encrypt/decrypt customer data. For key in Cloud KMS, the key should be in the format of `projects/*/locations/*/keyRings/*/cryptoKeys/*`.

CryptoKeyConfig.description: The crypto key configuration. This field is used by the Customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) feature.
